main_text.l: ILLUSTRI ET MAGNIFI-CO DOMINO, JOHANNI SKUMIN LITHUANO, CAPITANEO BRAS-EAVVIENSI, Fortunatus Crellius, Philosophus
CUi dono Veterem nouum Libellum, nouam de re Veteri-noua disputationem? tibi, Jo-hannes illustis. nam tu & nos, & nostra soles adamare.

Ex quo enim ad nos appulisti, statim, nulla interposita mora, Logicos nostros, quos è limpidissimo fonte deduximus, riuulos, cum generoso Slopecio, & alijs, tibi degustādos existimasti. quos ita degustasti: ut penitus eos exhausis-se videare, probat id perennis nostra disputandi ratio,
Instructus acie Logica jam in ipsa Na-turae arcana vis intueri. prudentissime. nosti enim, quid generosos & Magnificos, quid illustres & principes Viros de-

page.notes: The woodcut ornament at the top and the woodcut initial "C" are decorative and not transcribed. Faint mirrored text from the reverse side (show-through) is ignored. "illustis." is printed as such (probably for "illustris"); kept as printed. "existimasti.quos" has no space after the full stop in the print; kept as printed. "exhausis-se" is set with a hyphen at the line end, as printed. The printed "Io-hannes" and the title's "IOHANNI" use I as a consonant and are given as J, with the rest of the text transcribed as printed.
